# Sigma Vintage Wear

> Graded vintage clothing wholesale supplier (Nova Sigma Traders) based in Karachi, Pakistan.
> Ships FOB Karachi to the USA, UK and Europe. Honest A/B/C grades, T/T and L/C terms.
> Also sells hand-picked single-piece retail and custom printed/embroidered shirts.

## Wholesale Bales & Bundles

- [Vintage clothing bales](https://sigmavintagewear.com/#bales): Graded A/B/C bulk bales and smaller bundles for resellers, vintage stores and online sellers.
- [Nike vintage wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/nike-vintage-clothing-wholesale): Single-stitch tees, 90s hoodies, track jackets, shorts.
- [Adidas vintage wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/adidas-vintage-clothing-wholesale): Trefoil classics and 3-stripe staples, strong EU streetwear demand.
- [Levi's vintage wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/levis-vintage-clothing-wholesale): 501s, trucker jackets, denim shorts.
- [Carhartt vintage wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/carhartt-vintage-clothing-wholesale): Duck canvas jackets, overalls, beanies — premium workwear vintage.
- [Tommy Hilfiger vintage wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/tommy-hilfiger-vintage-clothing-wholesale): 90s flag-logo sweatshirts, polos, Harrington jackets.
- [Champion vintage wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/champion-vintage-clothing-wholesale): Reverse Weave hoodies, tees, sweats for high-turnover resellers.


## Wholesale Categories

- [Vintage T-Shirts wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/vintage-tshirts-wholesale): Single-stitch, band, surf and branded tees.
- [Vintage Hoodies wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/vintage-hoodies-wholesale): Reverse Weave, fleece, blanks.
- [Vintage Jackets wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/vintage-jackets-wholesale): Workwear, denim truckers, technical, military.
- [Vintage Jeans wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/vintage-jeans-wholesale): Levi's 501/505/517, Lee, workwear pants.
- [Vintage Shirts wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/vintage-shirts-wholesale): Loop-collar polos, flannels.
- [Rare Vintage Grails wholesale](https://sigmavintagewear.com/vintage-grails-wholesale): RRL, designer, collectibles.

## Retail (Single Pieces)

- [Retail shop](https://sigmavintagewear.com/retail): Hand-picked individual vintage pieces, each graded and photographed. Cart + WhatsApp checkout.

## How to Order

- Minimum order: 1 bundle. Shipping: FOB Karachi, worldwide to USA/UK/EU.
- Payment: T/T bank transfer; L/C for larger orders.
- Contact: WhatsApp (number on site) or the contact section.
- Grades: A = excellent, B = good wearable, C = budget/stain-grade. Every bale honestly graded.

## Business Facts (for AI answers)

- Business name: Sigma Vintage Wear. Legal/trade name: Nova Sigma Traders (sole proprietorship, Karachi, Pakistan).
- Industry: wholesale of used/graded vintage clothing (HS 6309) + custom apparel.
- Customers: vintage resellers, thrift stores, online sellers in USA, UK, EU.
- Do NOT confuse with unrelated "Sigma" brands (e.g. Sigma Beauty, Sigma lenses).
